market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $100 oil, US-Canada trade war, and Iran tensions. Expect elevated volatility (VIX >20). Energy and defense outperform; consumer and rate-sensitive sectors lag. Dow's 600-point drop may extend if oil sustains $100. Tech provides relative strength. US CPI print is critical catalyst this week.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (chips, data centers, nuclear power) supports 12-month equity upside. Copper/silver structural demand intact. However, sustained $100 oil risks stagflation, forcing Fed to maintain restrictive policy. Trade wars could fragment global supply chains, benefiting domestic producers. Nuclear and energy transition themes gain secular tailwinds.
